train_detectron_network: train a Detectron network using a config file with optional multi-GPU support and custom options
test_trained_model: test a trained Detectron model file by running inference and checking expected results
parse_training_args: parse command-line arguments for training including config file path and skip-test flag
merge_config_from_file: merge training configuration options from a YAML config file into the Detectron cfg object
run_inference_on_model: run inference on a trained model file with optional multi-GPU testing enabled
